name: mac-parallel-accelerator
description: AtomLane compiles local work into semantics-preserving atomic plans and executes proven-safe concurrency for Codex on macOS.

interface.shortDescription: Proven-safe parallel execution for coding agents
interface.longDescription: AtomLane compiles shell, package, Make, Compose, test, build, and declared task entrypoints into immutable hashed atomic plans. It preserves typed control flow and effects, fails closed on unknown hazards, delegates concurrency to native owners when safer, adapts to Apple silicon resources, and executes the exact verified plan with live progress and honestly labeled time savings.
defaultPrompt: Use $accelerate-local-work to run only the concurrency proven safe for this project.
Use $accelerate-local-work to accelerate this build, test, Docker, or research workflow.
Use $accelerate-local-work with live progress and per-run plus cumulative time savings.
